translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses, speaking.
translations.2: 'Exact the vengeance of the sons of Israel upon the Midianites; after that, you shall be gathered to your people.'
translations.3: And Moses spoke to his people, saying: 'Detach from among you men for the army, to campaign against Midian, that the vengeance of God may fall upon them.'
translations.4: 'A thousand from each tribe, from the tribes of the sons of Israel, you shall send forth for the campaign.'
translations.5: And there were singled out from the thousands of the sons of Israel, a thousand from each tribe; and they became twelve thousand equipped for the campaign.
translations.6: And Moses sent them forth — and Phinehas son of Eleazar the imām with them for the campaign — with the sacred vessels and the rallying trumpets in his hand.
translations.7: And they campaigned against Midian, as God had commanded Moses, and they slew every male.
translations.8: And they slew the five kings of Midian together with their slain — Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba — and also Balaam son of Beor they slew with the sword.
translations.9: And the sons of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their children; and all their beasts and their livestock, and their furnishings they plundered.
translations.10: And all their towns, together with their dwellings and their palaces, they burned with fire.
translations.11: And they took all the spoil and the fay — from the people and the beasts.
translations.12: And they came to Moses, and to Eleazar the imām, and to the assembly of the sons of Israel, with the captives and the fay and the plunder, to the encampment — to the wilderness plain of Moab, which is by the Jordan of Jericho.
translations.13: And Moses and Eleazar the imām, and the rest of the chiefs of the assembly, went out to meet them, outside the encampment.
translations.14: And Moses was wrathful with those entrusted over the army — the commanders of the thousands and the commanders of the hundreds — who were coming from the battle.
translations.15: And Moses said to them: 'Have you let every female live?'
translations.16: 'Were not these the ones who were to the sons of Israel, by the word of Balaam, until they brought about a breach of faith with God on account of Peor — and so the pestilence fell upon the assembly of God?'
translations.17: 'And now: kill every male among the children, and every woman who has known the lying with men — kill her.'
translations.18: 'And the rest of the female children, who have not known the lying with men — let them live for yourselves.'
translations.19: 'And as for you — encamp outside the encampment seven days; every one who has slain a person, and every one who has approached a slain man, shall be purified on the third day and on the seventh day — you and your captives.'
translations.20: 'And every garment and every vessel of leather, and anything made of fine soft wool and vessels of wood — purify them.'
translations.21: Then Eleazar the imām said to the men, the warriors, who were coming from the battle: 'This is the ordinance of the law which God commanded Moses.'
translations.22: 'As for the gold and the silver, the copper and the iron, the tin and the lead —'
translations.23: 'every thing that can enter into fire — pass it through the fire and it shall be clean; and it shall also be purified with the water of sprinkling. And everything that cannot enter into fire — pass it through the water.'
translations.24: 'And wash your garments on the seventh day, and be clean; and after that you shall enter the encampment.'
translations.25: And God said to Moses, saying:
translations.26: 'Take up the total count of what is in the captivity — of people and of beasts — you and Eleazar the imām and the heads of the fathers of the assembly.'
translations.27: 'And divide it between the men of war who went out for the campaign, and the rest of the assembly.'
translations.28: 'And levy a tax for God from the men of war who went out for the campaign: one head from every five hundred, of the people, and of the cattle, and of the donkeys, and of the flock.'
translations.29: 'Take that from their portion as an elevation-gift for God, and deliver it to Eleazar the imām.'
translations.30: 'And from the portion of the sons of Israel, take one from every fifty — of the people, and of the cattle, and of the donkeys, and of the flock, and the rest of the beasts — and deliver it to the Levites, the keepers of the charge of the tabernacle of God.'
translations.31: And Moses and Eleazar the imām did as God had commanded Moses.
translations.32: And the fay — the total of the plunder which the raiding people had plundered — the number of the flock: six hundred thousand and seventy-five thousand.
translations.33: And the number of the cattle: seventy-two thousand.
translations.34: And the number of the donkeys: sixty-one thousand.
translations.35: And from the people, from the women who had not known the lying with men: thirty-two thousand.
translations.36: And the half thereof — being the portion of those who went out for the campaign — the number of the flock: three hundred thousand and thirty-seven thousand and five hundred.
translations.37: And the number of the tax for God from the flock was six hundred and seventy-five head.
translations.38: And the number of the cattle: thirty-six thousand; and their tax for God: seventy-two.
translations.39: And the number of the donkeys: thirty thousand and five hundred; and their tax for God: sixty-one.
translations.40: And the number of persons: sixteen thousand; and their tax for God: thirty-two persons.
translations.41: And Moses delivered the tax levied for God to Eleazar the imām, as God had commanded him.
translations.42: And from the count of the portion of the sons of Israel which Moses had divided from the raiding people —
translations.43: that was, from the flock: three hundred thousand and thirty-seven thousand and five hundred;
translations.44: and from the cattle: thirty-six thousand;
translations.45: and from the donkeys: thirty thousand and five hundred;
translations.46: and from the persons: sixteen thousand —
translations.47: Moses took from that one from every fifty, of the people and the beasts, and delivered it to the Levites, the keepers of the charge of the tabernacle of God, as He had commanded him.
translations.48: Then those entrusted over the thousands of the army — the commanders of the thousands and the commanders of the hundreds — came forward to Moses,
translations.49: and said to Moses: 'Your servants have tallied the total of the men of war who are with us, and not a man is missing from us.'
translations.50: 'And we have brought forward the offering of God — every man among us who found golden vessels: armlets and bracelets, rings and earrings and girdles — to seek forgiveness for our souls before God.'
translations.51: And Moses and Eleazar the imām received that gold from them — every wrought vessel.
translations.52: And all the gold of the elevation-gifts which they raised up for God was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty weights, from the commanders of the thousands and from the commanders of the hundreds.
translations.53: As for the rest of the men of the campaign — whatever each one had plundered belonged to him.
translations.54: And when Moses and Eleazar the imām had received the gold from the commanders of the thousands and the hundreds, they brought it to the tent of the assembly, as a memorial for the sons of Israel before God.
